name: specswarm-marketplace
description: SpecSwarm: complete software development toolkit. Spec-driven workflows, autonomous orchestration, lifecycle management Build->Modify->Fix->Ship.

plugins.name: ss
plugins.description: SpecSwarm v7 — Build, Modify, Fix, and Ship with natural language. Spec-driven development with subagent-powered foundation-file generation that reads your project's existing spec corpus. Commands at /ss:*.

plugins.name: ss-status
plugins.description: SpecSwarm status line — your statusline plus a real-time background-builder segment (🔨 building / 💀 died / ✓ safe to close). Wraps any existing statusline; one-time /ss-status:install, then zero commands. No daemon, reboot-proof.

plugins.name: specswarm
plugins.description: DEPRECATED — SpecSwarm commands have moved to the `ss` plugin. Install `ss@specswarm-marketplace` and uninstall this plugin. Slated for full removal in v8.0.0.
